name: claude-imgview
description: imgview: preview images inside Claude Code.

plugins.name: imgview
plugins.description: Preview images inside Claude Code: each image a reply names, and each image pasted into a prompt, gets a chip. Click a chip to open the picture in a pane. Set the preview option to show a small picture under each chip that scrolls with the text, or to pop it up when the pointer is on the chip. /img <path> opens any image. Pixels on kitty and Ghostty, colored block characters on every other terminal.
